name: us1-recognition-reorder
description: Reconcile a three-story specification, then a SECOND run reads a reordered and retitled copy of it: story 3 moved above story 1, story 2 retitled. Recognition keys on the durable identifier, not position or title, so no ticket is re-created and each ticket still holds the content of the story whose marker names it (FR-006, SC-005).
